intro: A neural network and tuned tree models were trained and scored on two measured surfactant properties (SURFPRO data). Scores come from cross-validation in which whole groups of related rows are held out together (5 repeats of the network). Lower error is better. Cleaning efficacy itself is not covered.

tasks.name: Critical micelle concentration
tasks.single: One network at a time: clearly better than the trees in 0 of 5 runs, clearly worse in 3.
tasks.extra: Against the average of the 3 best tree models (MAE 0.5218), the trees are clearly better than the network average: +0.0628 [+0.00367, +0.112].

tasks.name: Surface tension at the CMC
tasks.single: One network at a time: clearly better than the trees in 0 of 5 runs, clearly worse in 2.
tasks.extra: Against the average of the 3 best tree models (MAE 4.772), the trees are also clearly better than the network average: +0.447 [+0.232, +0.67].
